name: LangSmith
tagline: Observability and deployment for AI agents
description: LangSmith is LangChain's platform for tracing, evaluating and deploying AI applications, priced per seat plus pay-as-you-go usage.
features: Trace retention of 14 days (base) or 180 days (extended)
Deployments, sandboxes and an engine metered in LangChain Standard Units
Cloud data location in the US or EU
Self-hosted and hybrid options for Enterprise
strengths: Cloud data can be located in the US or the EU
limitations: Usage beyond the included allowance is pay-as-you-go
Tuned Evaluators are in public beta for Plus and Cloud Enterprise in the US only

plans.name: Developer
highlights: Up to 5k base traces per month

plans.name: Plus
highlights: Up to 10k base traces per month

free.details: Developer: $0 per seat per month, 1 seat, up to 5k base traces per month, then pay-as-you-go. Community support.

api.summary: Usage is metered in LangChain Standard Units (LSU) at $1.00 each. Developer includes 7 LSUs per organisation per month for Fleet and Plus includes 37.
